hypotheses.rate_distortion: Mirror+loop produces lower fresh NMSE than both equal-parameter same-address affine loop and ordinary sparse AE at identical feature-code length
hypotheses.localization: Mirror has more frequency-selective causal latent-coordinate ablations than affine and sparse while preserving reconstruction quality
hypotheses.sparsification: Low-gate graph edges can be masked without proportional quality deterioration

source.content_caution: one bundled recording; must not infer speech benchmark generalization

feature.scale: log1p(10 * mel-power), then per-band train-only standardization

external_recording: gradio/media_assets/audio/audio_sample.wav, 8 kHz, resample polyphase to 16 kHz, diagnostic only

latent.quantization: per-coordinate uint8 unsigned clipped 0..99.5th training-percentile and static train-only scale

graph.warp: one fixed orthogonal Householder -> tanh -> inverse Householder
graph.prune_test: eight smallest-gate edges masked at inference

fresh_usage: no fresh or late inputs used during training, early stopping or model hyperparameter selection; evaluate selected checkpoints only after all twelve runs

decision.mirror_quality: at least 5% lower fresh NMSE than affine on each of three paired seeds AND lower 3-seed median fresh NMSE than direct sparse
decision.mirror_localization: median top8 causal 8-band localization >=+0.05 absolute above both affine and sparse in all three seeds, with no >5% quality regression
decision.status_if_fail: FAIL at tested pilot regime, not architectural impossibility

limitations: logMel lossy features, no waveform decoder, training from single recording, no strong codec reproduction, fixed 500 optimizer updates not near-convergence capacity evidence
